sources.scope: Selected published reference components, not an identification of purchased clone modules

socket.note: Home-etched non-plated carrier uses round 1.1mm manual drill rather than factory finished 1.02mm; sockets must match the selected tail geometry.

capacitor.note: H5 selects formed 5mm lead spacing, not a 2.5mm L2 capacitor.

wire_ports.method: Soldered pigtail/wire landings; NOT direct module, Dupont2.54, or unspecified terminal-block footprints

remote_sensors.name: SparkFun SEN-11028 MPU6050 reference
remote_sensors.mount: External pigtail; board size does not define a carrier footprint

remote_sensors.name: Adafruit 2651 BMP280 published reference
remote_sensors.mount: External pigtail; revisions vary, no carrier mounting holes implied

remote_sensors.name: DFRobot SEN0102 HMC5883L reference (retired)
remote_sensors.mount: External pigtail; optional and driver pending

remote_sensors.name: Nooploop TOFSense-F2 Mini V1.0 reference
remote_sensors.mount: External cable; connector spacing is not carrier hole pitch

usb_access.status: Conservative 15mm service envelope; plug/cable height and actual module variant remain unmeasured

restrictions: Sensor clone pin order/size is not universal
F450 mounting coordinates are still user-measurement dependent
No high-current ESC or motor footprint is included
Antenna keepout is a design envelope, not a manufactured RF test
